title: Quasi-coherent derived projection mate with fixed adjunction and tensor comparison
statement: Let X and Y be quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme], with derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and their canonical tensor structures [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Let f:X\to Y be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, let F=Lf^* [def-pc-derived-pullback] and R=Rf_* [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and let p:F\dashv R be an adjunction with counit \epsilon. Let t:F(-\otimes^L-)\simeq F(-)\otimes^L F(-) be a natural isomorphism of bifunctors. For M\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y) and L\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X), the transpose under p of t_{M,R(L)} followed by 1_{F(M)}\otimes\epsilon_L is an isomorphism M\otimes^L R(L)\to R(F(M)\otimes^L L).

source.place: Tag 08EU, lemma-cohomology-base-change; fourth Hom equality of duality.tex Tag 0A9Q, lemma-iso-on-RSheafHom

proof.text: Write pi(M,L) for the displayed mate; it is natural by t, counit and Hom-equivalence naturality. Use the open-cover isomorphism detection of [lem-pc-projection-locality]. Restriction to an open is a localization with fully faithful derived right adjoint. Pullback and tensor commute with restriction by [lem-pc-affine-derived-pullback-tensor-tilde], and direct image does so by [lem-pc-restrict-derived-direct-image-open]. The bifunctors underlying t descend through these localizations; transport t by evaluation on the right adjoints and the localization counit, and transport p likewise. The restricted mate is the mate for the transported p and t. This is descent of the arbitrary supplied comparison, not an identification with the canonical comparison.

On an affine target Spec A, [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence] identifies the test object M with an A-module complex. Pullback preserves coproducts by its left adjunction, tensor does so by [lem-sc-derived-tensor-right-coproducts], and R preserves the required quasi-coherent coproducts by [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-preserves-direct-sums]. The pullback and tensor objects stay quasi-coherent by [lem-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-qcoh] and [lem-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-qcoh].

For a shifted free rank-one module, identify F(M tensor B) and F(M) tensor F(B) with shifted F(B). The supplied natural isomorphism t then gives a natural automorphism of shifted F. Its adjunction mate is a natural automorphism of shifted R: the adjunction conjugate of t inverse is the inverse, by the two triangle identities. Consequently the projection components on all shifted free generators are invertible. For the canonical comparison this is the usual counit triangle calculation in the final sentence of Tag 08EU. This calculation must be made for the supplied t, which the parent does not assume canonical.

Fix L and use the property P(M) that pi(M[n],L) is invertible for every integer n. Apply [lem-pc-derived-module-free-generation]. Coproduct preservation gives coproduct closure, and retract closure is formal. For a distinguished triangle and all its shifts, apply Hom(T,-) for every ambient T to the two exact image functors. Naturality at the triangle arrows and connecting arrows gives a diagram of exact sequences whose vertical maps are pi at each shifted vertex. If P holds for two vertices, the five lemma proves it for the third, then Yoneda detects invertibility. This needs no assumption that t commutes with a chosen shift comparison. The shifted-unit calculation proves P on every generator. Open-cover detection completes the argument; zero objects and empty schemes cause no exception.

lean.statement:
theorem qcqsDerivedProjectionMate_isIso (X Y : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (p : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (t : tensor (schemeDerivedCategory Y) ⋙ derivedPullback f ≅
      (derivedPullback f).prod (derivedPullback f) ⋙ tensor (schemeDerivedCategory X))
    (M : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (L : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) :
    IsIso (p.homEquiv (M.obj ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj L.obj)
      ((derivedPullback f).obj M.obj ⊗ L.obj)
        (t.hom.app (M.obj, (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj L.obj) ≫
          (𝟙 ((derivedPullback f).obj M.obj) ⊗ₘ p.counit.app L.obj)))
